༄༅/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas gsal ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: bzhugs so/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas byang chub mngon par 'dus ma byas/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i yon tan lhun grub cing*/ /glo bur khams stong thog mtha' med pa'i dbyings/ /rnam dag byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu rmad byung gang*/ /rdo rje rtse mo lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de nyid nges pa'i don/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur sems nyid 'od gsal khams/ /rang bzhin rnam dag bde gshegs snying po la/ /ma rig gzung 'dzin glo bur bsgribs pa yis/ /kun tu brtags pa yun ring goms byas pas/ /yul dang don dang sems su bag chags te/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs mngon par grub/ /thog mtha' med can shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin/ khams gsum rigs drug bde sdug sna tshogs snang*/ /rang rang las kyis nye bar bkod can no/ /'di kun rang bzhin rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /dri za'i grong dang sprul pa mig yor tshul/ /brag cha chu zla 'dra zhing snying po med/ gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla 'dra zhing*/ /rkyen snang rten cing 'brel 'byung ngo bo nyid/ /ma brtags nyams dga' brtags na ngos bzung med/ /med pa gsal snang stong pa'i rang gzugs ste/ /snang ba'i dus na bden pa'i rang bzhin med/ /med la yod par bzung bas brtags pa tsam/ /gzung ba'i yul med rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'gros/ /gzugs sogs yul lngar rang snang stong gzugs bzhin/ /ngo bo cha shas rang bzhin med pa ste/ /gzhi med gnas med yul dngos grub pa med/ /de phyir bzung dang gzung yul grub pa med/ /rnam kun stong par gdod nas dag pa yin/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyang rang bzhin yod min te/ /kun gzhir brten pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang*/ /yid dang nyon yid sgo lnga'i shes pa ste/

/rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems kyi rnam pa yang*/ /rig pa'i cha la ma rig sgro btags kyi/ /kun du brtags pas sems zhes mtshon pa tsam/ /don gyi ngo bo rang stobs rig pa ste/ khyad par gzhan stobs sems byung lnga bcu gcig /dpyad na rgyun dang skad cig cha shas med/ /dus gsum dngos med skye 'gag gnas pas stong*/ /gang gis gang 'dzin de la rang bzhin ci/ kha dog dbyibs med phyogs cha mtha' dbus med/ /bsam dang bral ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin can/ /dngos dang dngos po med pa'i mtshams las 'das/ /ye nas bdag med spros dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'dzin pa'i sems la rang bzhin med pa lags/ /de ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa med pa nyid/ /gdod nas rnam dag don gyi gnas lugs te/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i dri ma bden stong phyir/ /'khor ba ming tsam sgyu mar rtogs byas nas/ /brten gzhi 'od gsal snying po'i khams la 'jug /snod bcud brten gzhi nam mkha'i dbyings rum bzhin/ /'khor 'das kun 'byung rig pa byang chub sems/ /mtha' dang dbus med yangs pachen po'i klong*/ /stong gsal 'gyur med spros dang bral ba ni/ /nyi mkha' bzhin te rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /nor bu bzhin te yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /thog mtha' med de dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /'dus ma byas te rgyu rkyen kun las 'das/ / don dam dbyings te zab cing rgya che'i gnas/ /kun la yod kyang rtogs par dka' ba'i don/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur spros dang bral ba lags/ /nam mkha'i ngang du snod bcud shar ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad rig pa'i ngang du snang*/ /mkha' dang snod bcud ngang dang ngang can ltar/ /rig dang chos kun dbyings dang dbyings snang ste/ /snang dang snang gzhi dpyad na stong pa'i ngang*/ / gcig dang du ma'i cha shas kun las 'das/ /snod bcud chags 'jigs 'pho ldeg ci byung yang*/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa ltar/ /snang srid 'khor 'das bzang ngan ci byung yang*/

/rig pa'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba med par gnas/ /rig pa ye stong rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /'di zhes mi mtshon bsam brjod kun las 'das/ /yod min med min yod med mtha' dang bral/ /dbus shes mi dmigs gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /ye nas lhun grub byang chub sems kyi ngang*/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nyid/ / kun 'byung gang yin shel dang nor bu bzhin/ /phyogs dang ris bral dag cing dri ma med/ /gnyis med bsam bral 'gyur med de bzhin nyid/ /don dam snying po gdod ma'i sangs rgyas te/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi yi gnas lugs lags/ /dbyings gzhir ma rtogs stong pa lta ba dang*/ /stongs pa nyi tshe dbyings la bdag tu 'dzin/ /rtag chad nyid de mtha' bral don dang 'gal/ /'khor ba gzhi med mtshan nyid chad pa dang*/ /mya ngan 'das gzhi lhun gyis grub pa gnyis/ /dbyings dang dbyings snang mkha' dang sprin tshogs bzhin/ /nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan lhun grub kun/ /dbyings la yod kyang sgrib pa ma dag pa/ /glo bur dri bcas sprin rum nyi ma bzhin/ /de gsal ched du lam gyis 'bad pa dang*/ /dag pa nyi mkha' 'bras bu'i gnas skabs rnams/ /dbyings dang ngang nas 'pho dang 'gyur med pas/ /lhun grub 'dus ma byas dbyings yon tan la/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de'i rang bzhin nyid/ /gzhi gcig steng na de ltar gnas pa ni/ /sprin gyis ma dag dag dang rnam dag des/ /rim bzhin dbyings la dri bcas gzhi dang ni/ /lam gyi phyogs gcig dag dang 'bras bu'i dus/ /shin tu rnam dag nyi mkha' rang bzhin bzhin/ /'di dang dbyings gcig gzhi las ma g.yos dpe/ /sems nyid 'od gsal lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /chos rnams kun gyis gzhi mar shes par bya/ /don 'di 'khor lo tha ma'i dgongs pa ste/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nges don lags/ /'di ltar sus shes skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ / 'dus ma byas dbyings shin tu rnam dag la/

/stongs sogs dbyings kyi yon tan ye ldan dang*/ /glo bur rnam dag dri bral yon tan ldan/ /'di gnyis dbye ba ma nor shin tu gces/ /gzhi yi chos sku stobs sogs yod smra yi/ /dag pa gnyis ldan yon tan de lta min/ /dri bcas dri med skabs yin de yi phyir/ / lhun grub dbyings kyi yon tan nyid dang ni/ /mngon gyur 'bras bu'i yon tan la ltos nas/ /gzhi dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs gnyis dag las/ / dbyings 'di rang bzhin rnam par dag pa can/ /gzhi yi chos su mkhas pas rig par bya/ /lam ni dbyings kyi dri ma bsal bas te/ /dbang bzhis smin pa'i rig pa byang chub sems/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba ste/ /zab mo'i gnad kyi nyams su len par 'dod/ /'dir ni rang gi mos dge phun tshogs dang*/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs shin tu rmad byung mthus/ /chos rnams bdag med spros dang bral ba'i don/ /sems nyid 'od gsal gzhi yi gnas lugs nyid/ /dbang khrid gdams pas legs par ngo 'phrod pa/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba lags par gsungs/ /de'i phyir gzhi dang lta ba byed pa gces/ /gzhi ni dbyings kyi gnas lugs don yin la/ /lta ba de nyid rtogs pa'i rang bzhin lags/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la 'jog pa sgom pa ste/ / rnam par mi rtog yengs med spros dang bral/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ bsam brjod mtshon 'das rig pa byang chub sems/ / rang rnal ngang gnas sgom pa'i rgyal po lags/ /de tshe bying rgod mtshan ma rab zhi la/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams skye 'dzin zhen med/ /tshogs drug lhug pa sgo lnga rgya yan nyid/ /rig pa rten med phyal pa bar snang 'dra/ /phyi nang bar med zang thal chen po ste/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs par rang byung ye shes ni/ / mtha' grol klong yangs chen por shes par bya/ /sems can sems dang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gnyis/ /rig pa khol bu rgya yan khyad par te/ /yul gcig yid byed 'du shes gzeb la thogs/

khams gsum sems can rang rang dmigs dang bcas/ /de las rnam 'das phyogs dang ris med pa/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lags/ / ༈ rgyal ba byas kyang rang byung ye shes ngang*/ /rang mal gnas pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nyid/ /sems can byas kyang rang gnas ma rtogs pa/ / sems dang sems byung kun rtog gzung 'dzin nyid/ /rtog dang mi rtog mtshan ma'i ngang la gnas/ /'dod gzugs gzugs med sems gsum ra ba ru/ / rang byung ye shes bcings nas bdag tu bzung*/ /de bas rtogs dang mi rtog dus kun tu/ /rig pa rang gsal rgya yan zang thal nyid/ /rang gnas mnyam pa'i dgongs pa shes par bya/ /'di nyid shes pas kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /snying po'i de nyid rtogs pa'i ngang gnas zhes/ /mtshungs med chos rje bla ma de skad gsungs/ /mchog gsum rdo rje snying po'i khang bzangs su/ /mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas gsum chos nyid 'khor lor gnas pa'i tshe/ /rtsa gsum dbu ma dag pa'i rang bzhin du/ /srog rtsol nyi zla'i 'jug pa nub gyur pas/ /rlung sems mi g.yo shin tu dag pa na/ /bde chen 'od kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /ye shes ro gcig dbyings dang rnam 'dres pas/ /nang gi de nyid 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe/ /nyi dang zer bzhin chos dbyings rig pa'i gdangs/ /ye shes srog rlung kha dog 'byed pa las/ /phyi rol rnam kun stong pa'i 'od gsal gzugs/ /mngon sum yul du snang ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ /phra mo'i rlung zin 'byung lnga'i khyad par las/ / rtags bcu rnam dag med bzhin snang ba ni/ /dag pa'i mkha' la gza' skar bkram pa bzhin/ /de tshe rang bzhin gcig ste gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gar yang mi 'dzin cir yang mi rtog pas/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin shes rab ba rol phyin/ /zung 'jug dbyer med rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /bzhi pa'i de nyid phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mtha' gnyis gnas gsal dbu ma'i rang bzhin te/

/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs shul lags/ /gang tshe gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis med par/ /blo yi mdun na 'jug pa rab zhi ba/ /de tshe bsam brjod spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ma skyes rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid la/ / yang dang yang du nyin mtshan legs bsgoms pas/ /sna tshogs dngos dang de blo mi dmigs par/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs zad pa la/ /phyi rol snang ba'i 'od gsal dbyings nub ste/ /nyi bral rkyen gyis shel 'od nang gnas ltar/ /rig pa gzung 'dzin rlung dang bral ba las/ /ye shes rlung lnga rang mal dbyings su thim/ /nang gi de nyid shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /ma lus dbyings gcig gdod ma'i sar gzhol te/ /rang rig rdo rje snying po'i dbyings la 'jug /de ltar bsgom pas sa lam gang bgrod de/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin sogs/ /yon tan ches mchog gong ma brnyes pa lags/ /mnyam gzhag chos nyid zab mo'i rang bzhin du/ /zag med dge ba spros dang bral ba'i tshe/ /rtogs dang ngang gnas snang la 'dzin med pas/ /lta sgom spyod gsum ngo bo gcig pa la/ / rtogs pas tha dad tsam du shes par bya/ /rjes thob rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul tsam du/ /sbyin sogs dge ba 'khor gsum dag par spyad/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun/ /dbyings snang bden med sgyu mar rnam sbyong ba/ /'di dag lta sgom spyod pa'i rim pa lags/ /mdor na gzhi dbyings rtogs pa lta ba ste/ /ngang la mi rtog yengs med sgom pa'i mchog /rmi lam sgyu ma bden med spyod pa'i tshul/ /thams cad rig pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ / lam gyi chos shes bla ma sangs rgyas gsungs/ /'di dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/ khams de'i dri ma ma lus dag pa'i tshe/ /sprin bral nyi bzhin dbyings kyi yon tan kun/ /ma lus mngon gyur byang chub chen po ste/ /dag pa gnyis ldan lhun grub rang snang las/

/spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun tshogs ldan/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa brnyes/ /de tshe dbyings kyi sku gsum ro gcig pas/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul sku gsum nyag cig las/ /ye shes phrin las dag pa'i gzugs sku gnyis/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs gdul bya'i smon lam mthus/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin so sor snang ba yis/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ /nges med sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis/ /gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /nor bu ji bzhin 'dod dgu'i re ba skor/ /srid pa ji srid gzhan don rgyun mi chad/ /de dag mtha' phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa lags/ /ye nas lhun grub dbyings kyi sku gsum dang*/ /gdul bya'i rang snang phrin las gzugs sku gnyis/ /mkha' dbyings ston zla dngas pa'i mtshor snang bzhin/ /dbyings su dbyings snang de yi gzugs brnyan te/ / gcig dang tha dad mtha' las 'das tshul du/ /rgyal dang gdul bya'i ngo kha so sor snang*/ /de phyir 'di gnyis dbye ba shes pa gces/ /'di dag 'dres nas gcig tu shes pa na/ /rgyal ba'i chos sku 'gro la snang bar rigs/ /ngo bo gcig pa'i gzugs sku snang ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las te/ /dag pa'i sems can gyis kyang bsam bya min/ /'di ni rgyal ba rnams kyi spyod yul lo/ /zhes sogs lung gi yang dag dmigs phye bas/ /dbyings dang ye shes phrin las skur shes bya/ /de ltar rtogs na skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ /tshul 'di nges pa'i don gyi snying po ste/ /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyis mthar thug yin/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus dbyings gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas gsal ba zhes bya ba/ mang du thos pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/

gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas gsal ba/ - PAGE 210 -- PAGE 217 - - PAGE 209 -
